habitLoop.question: Do you watch porn only when you masturbate?
habitLoop.questionPrompt: Select your honest experience to see what happens inside your brain:
habitLoop.yesQuote: “I only watch porn when I masturbate.”
habitLoop.yesExplanation: But if you repeat this again and again, your brain can start connecting porn and masturbation together as one habit.
habitLoop.patternHeading: Over time, the pattern can become:
habitLoop.yesDilemmaLabel: And then you may start feeling:
habitLoop.yesDilemma: “I try to stop this habit, but I fail every time. I feel like I can never stop, and I feel so bad about myself.”
habitLoop.yesWarning: You promise yourself it was the last time, but when the urge strikes again, you give in and feel terrible. If this sounds like you, don't ignore it. This is the right time to understand your habit and start changing it.
habitLoop.noQuote: “I don't watch porn every time, so I'm in control.”
habitLoop.noExplanation: Even if they aren't paired together every single time, watching porn primes your brain's dopamine reward circuitry for artificial highs.
habitLoop.noDilemmaLabel: And then you may start feeling:
habitLoop.noDilemma: “I told myself I can quit whenever I want, but I keep going back to it anyway.”
habitLoop.noWarning: Separating the two gives a false sense of control while the urge quietly deepens. Stepping away from porn early is the smartest choice to protect your focus and mental peace.
habitLoop.ctaHeading: You only need to take the first step.
habitLoop.ctaSubheading: We'll help you understand the rest.

pullQuote.author: — AxoMen Founding Team

2019.label: The Realisation
2019.content: Long before the lockdowns, a few of us — students, young professionals — were quietly watching something disturbing unfold in our circles. Friends who were smart, capable, full of potential were slowly withdrawing. Energy gone. Confidence shattered. Relationships struggling. The common thread? Hours lost to porn every single day. Nobody was talking about it. Nobody had a name for it. We did.

2020.label: The Breaking Point
2020.content: Then COVID-19 arrived. India locked down. Overnight, millions of young men — students, college boys, working professionals — were stuck at home with unlimited free time, a smartphone, and zero accountability. Porn site traffic in India didn't just grow. It exploded. One site alone saw 228 million Indian visits a month. The problem that was already spreading quietly now had rocket fuel. We knew we couldn't stay silent anymore.

2021.label: The Movement Begins
2021.content: AxoMen was born to provide men with honest, confidential support for sexual health and compulsive habit loops. Science-backed frameworks, real recovery stories, dopamine rewiring guidance. No shame, no lectures — just practical help for men who want to regain control.

storiesContent.rahul: I was failing two subjects and couldn't focus for even 10 minutes. After joining AxoMen, I got a 90-day roadmap that actually made sense. Today I cleared my backlogs and got a campus placement.
storiesContent.arjun: I couldn't look people in the eye. I thought it was just shyness. The platform showed me exactly why my confidence was gone and gave me daily check-ins to rebuild it. I'm a different person now.
storiesContent.vikram: My girlfriend was about to leave me. I didn't understand why I was emotionally numb. AxoMen's community made me realise the root cause. Six months later, my relationship is stronger than ever.
storiesContent.saurabh: I was sleeping 4 hours, watching content all night, and bombing every interview. The accountability system here forced me to fix my sleep and routine. I landed my first job offer within four months.
storiesContent.karthik: I was deep in depression for almost a year and had no idea porn was part of the problem. The science on this platform was the first thing that made everything click. I haven't relapsed in 8 months.
storiesContent.rohit: I dropped out of college in my second year because I couldn't function. I found AxoMen and went through the free recovery guide. I re-enrolled this year and I'm actually enjoying studies again.
storiesContent.ankit: I was terrified of talking to anyone in class. I thought I was just introverted. The community here had hundreds of guys like me. Knowing I wasn't alone changed everything. I joined my college fest committee last month.
storiesContent.dev: I lost a dream job at 22 because I was exhausted and unfocused all the time. I hit rock bottom and found this platform. Three years later I'm clean, I have a great job, and I mentor others here.
storiesContent.nikhil: The physical symptoms were scaring me — low energy, brain fog, zero motivation. Doctors found nothing wrong. AxoMen was the first place that connected all the dots. I feel 20 again — because I am 20.
storiesContent.prashant: I was hiding in my room all day and my parents thought something was deeply wrong. They were right. The AxoMen guide helped me have an honest conversation with my father. That talk changed my life.
